name: Jacob (Judith's 1949 abstract; Larry's father by sibling evidence) and Leah / Lee Yanowitz (Judith's 1949 abstract; combined sibling evidence)
text:
Core family
Children recorded: Lawrence (Larry) Hersh; Judith Dratler (nee Herskowitz) - 'Judy'.
Three further daughters (names not given in the 1984 interview, all younger than Larry, one younger than
Judy) perished with their parents; recorded on the parents' facts, no stub persons.
Sources: S036, S032, S033, S103, S066, S030, S039, S037, S038, S069, S051, S006, S089, S042
Judith's 1949 marriage abstract names her father Jacob and gives her mother's maiden name as Lee Yanowitz. Her 2025 obituary explicitly names Lawrence Hersh as her brother; together these support Larry's parental names, with Lee/Leah and Yanowitz/Janowitz variants retained. The uncle and lost sisters remain unidentified [S132, S103, S089].
baseline_name: Mr. Hersh(kovitz) of Khust (Larry's father) and Leah Hersh nee Janowitz (Larry's mother)
